ruleSection: ## 13a. Gather the context you do not have
claim: An agent asked to change code it has never seen gathers the missing context with ONE delegation before it writes, and the same run with this section stripped writes first.
prompt: Change the session store in this repository so a token expires after 15 minutes instead of 60. You have never seen this repository. Handle both halves of the job now: call zzdrill_delegate with the context-gathering task, and call zzdrill_write_code with the file you would change, in whichever order you judge correct. Do not ask me anything first.
